text:
Priya Nair: FYI — partner ingestion job spilled a staging DB url + password to stdout in a GCS log. Not prod, but creds look real. Need rotation + audit ASAP.
Brad Cole: saw it, grabbing logs: gs://redwood-staging/logs/partner-ingest/2026-03-20/*. One file has a full conn string. :eyes:
Priya Nair: I've suspended the partner's staging service account access to the bucket and disabled the pipeline run.
Kelly Zhou: good call. Did you check whether the secret was pulled from Vault or env var?
Brad Cole: looks like the process reads from Vault via vault-agent and also falls back to a plaintext env var if vaulted read fails. The log shows the fallback code path.
Tom Rivers: that's the risky bit — fallback allowed plaintext to be echoed. We should remove fallback and rotate secrets.
Priya Nair: agreed. Immediate action plan: 1) rotate staging DB creds in the DB, 2) rotate Vault secret versions / rewrap with KMS, 3) scan historic logs for exposure, 4) push RBAC change to disallow fallback.
Brenda Li: I'll own audit + rotation orchestration. Can someone post the exact vault path and KMS key alias?
Brad Cole: vault path: secret/data/staging/db/partner-ingest. KMS alias: projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/staging/cryptoKeys/redwood-staging-wrap
Priya Nair: DB host is staging-db.internal:5432 (we'll reprovision creds after notifying QA).
Kelly Zhou: for step 2 — we should rewrap Vault's transit key or at least re-encrypt the specific secret versions using the current KMS key. Ops, can you rewrap?
ops-bot: CI job queued: vault-rewrap-job-316777. Use command: `vault write transit/rewrap ciphertext=@old_ciphertext` (ensure KMS integration present).
Tom Rivers: also add audit entries to stackdriver and Vault audit devices. Brenda, can you enable extended retention for the next 30d for staging logs and export to an isolated GCS bucket for evidence?
Brenda Li: yes — enabling export and increasing retention now. I'll create a read-only export bucket `gs://redwood-sec-evidence/316777` and copy affected logs.
Priya Nair: Brad, can you run a grep scan across recent logs for credentials pattern and the exact DB host? Simple regex: `(?i)(postgres|psql|password|dbname|host)=`
Brad Cole: running scan now. Found 7 files across last 72h. Pushing list to the evidence bucket and marking filenames in the incident tracker.
Kelly Zhou: RBAC change: I pushed a limited role `staging/ingest-service-no-fallback` that only allows `vault read secret/data/staging/db/partner-ingest` and denies `env` fallback. Please review: `iam-policy diff` showed no prod impact.
Priya Nair: let's coordinate rotation window at 19:00 UTC to avoid overlapping QA runs. Can we do a canary rotate?
Tom Rivers: yes — canary for ingestion worker instances in zone-us-west1-b (2 instances) then full sweep. I'll prepare a script:

```
# rotate flow (staging)
vault kv put secret/staging/db/partner-ingest username=newuser password=$(generate-password)
# update DB creds
psql -h staging-db -c "ALTER USER olduser WITH PASSWORD 'rotated';"
```

Brad Cole: after DB rotate, we'll update the Vault record and run rewrap to ensure ciphertexts are using current KMS wrapping key.
Brenda Li: also revoking any active Vault tokens used by the pipeline: `vault token revoke -prefix=true <token>` and invalidating old service account keys for partner.
Priya Nair: note for compliance: we need an audit record with who rotated, timestamps, and the proof of copy of exposed logs. Brenda, can you export a signed bundle?
Brenda Li: will generate a signed bundle (GPG-signed manifest + SHA256 list) and attach to incident.
Kelly Zhou: small security ask: add a Vault policy check that forbids fallback env read in deployment manifests. I'll open a policy PR and tag @infra for rollout.
Tom Rivers: post-rotation, we'll run a smoke test of the ingest flow with a rotated test credential and monitor error rates / latency. Set an alert for >1% error spike.
Brad Cole: scan finished — list uploaded. No evidence of exfil to external partner S3, only internal GCS logs.
Priya Nair: timeline: rotate at 19:00 UTC, canary 19:00–19:10, full roll 19:10–19:25. Ops oncall: are you good for that window?
Tom Rivers: I'm primary oncall, will be watching. @ops-bot please post deploy events to #eng-oncall.
ops-bot: deploy events will be sent. Canary begun -> 316777-canary-1.
Brenda Li: rotation done for canary at 19:08 UTC. Vault entries updated and rewrapped with KMS alias. Logged in audit device.
Brad Cole: DB creds rotated on canary DB host and smoke ingestion succeeded.
Priya Nair: proceeding to full roll now. Reminder: don't merge the env-fallback revert PR until post-rollout verification.
Kelly Zhou: PR reverted fallback code pushed to staging; will hold until you say green.
Tom Rivers: full roll completed at 19:23 UTC. All ingest tasks report success. No elevated errors.
Brenda Li: evidence bundle created and uploaded to `gs://redwood-sec-evidence/316777/manifest.gpg`. Audit logs show all relevant vault reads/revokes.
Priya Nair: good job. Postmortem items: 1) remove fallback permanently, 2) add static analysis to CI to detect plaintext creds in code, 3) RBAC hardening for service accounts, 4) schedule roadshow with partner to fix their deployment. I've opened a postmortem ticket.
Brad Cole: adding checklist for partners: no fallback, vault-agent mandatory, log scrubbing, least-priv SA.
Kelly Zhou: I'll follow up with a policy PR to enforce vault-agent injection for our k8s deployment default.
Tom Rivers: closing incident thread once postmortem is linked. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
